findings.claim: The pre-push hook exits 0 without running precheck, classification or traceability when every pushed ref is a deletion, including a deletion of a protected branch such as develop or main.
findings.impact: Deleting a protected branch on the remote is no longer gated. Before this commit the same push ran precheck and traceability on HEAD, so a deletion that the old hook blocked now goes through.
findings.evidence: .githooks/pre-push:26-30 sends deletion lines to continue before PROTECTED_PUSH is set. Lines 36-39 exit 0 before PRECHECK (line 42), CLASSIFY (line 44) and TRACE (lines 46-48). The removed loop set PROTECTED_PUSH for every ref matching a protected branch, deletions included.
findings.repro: not_reproduced. By reading: a deletion push of develop while HEAD fails check-traceability was blocked before this commit and is accepted after it. Not run, because this session has no shell.

bucket_proposal.reason: The commit message states the intent (a deletion sends no commits), so this reads as a deliberate behavior change. No declared invariant exists, so bucket A is not available.

findings.proposed_fix: Run precheck for deletions of protected branches, or record the bypass in docs/process/EXCEPTIONS.md if the change is intended.

findings.claim: Nothing in the repository tests the pre-push hook, so the new deletion-only exit path and the REFS/UPDATES counting have no test.
findings.impact: A later edit to the ref-line parsing can break the deletion skip or the protected-branch detection while every test still passes.
findings.evidence: Glob over scripts/process/** finds no test or bats file, and .github/workflows/process.yml has no reference to pre-push or githooks (Grep: no matches).
findings.repro: not_reproduced. Checked by Glob and Grep only.

bucket_proposal.reason: It reads as a coverage gap for the hook. It does not break a declared invariant.

findings.proposed_fix: Add a hook test that feeds deletion-only, mixed and protected-branch ref lines on stdin and checks the exit code and which step runs.

findings.claim: The diff reaches four paths that are not in any touch-point list, because no invariants file exists for this change: .githooks/pre-push, .process-kit.lock, CLAUDE.md and docs/process/codex.md.
findings.impact: None on its own. It answers the first-review question: every path is unlisted.
findings.evidence: The diff header lists these four paths. The lock entry for docs/process/codex.md is added to .process-kit.lock, which makes the file protected under scripts/process/classify-risk.sh:333.
findings.repro: not_reproduced. Answered from the diff and the absence of an invariants file.

bucket_proposal.reason: Informational only. A person decides whether the list must be created.

findings.proposed_fix: No code change is needed. Create an invariants file if a touch-point list is wanted.

specification_compliance: The docs/process/codex.md text points at files that exist: workflow.md, .claude/commands/spec.md, .claude/agents/acceptance-test-writer.md, .claude/agents/r5-runner.md, .claude/commands/review.md, scripts/process/review.sh and .claude/rules/process.md (checked by Glob).
The pre-push code matches its header comment: a push that only deletes refs runs no step.
No gitlink or submodule path is in the diff; .gitmodules lists four addons, and none of them is touched.
potential_unspecified_behavior: A push that deletes a protected branch and also updates a non-protected branch still runs the checks, because UPDATES is counted per ref, not per protected branch. The result depends on ref order and is not specified.
regression_risks: Deleting develop or main is no longer gated by precheck or traceability (F1).
The lock hashes added for .githooks/pre-push and docs/process/codex.md were not recomputed here. If they are wrong, classify-risk will treat the file contents as drift.
test_coverage: No automated test covers the hook. The deletion skip, the mixed deletion-and-update case and the protected-branch detection are verified by reading only (F2).
The scripts under scripts/process/ are not executed in this review.
not_verified: The SHA-256 values in .process-kit.lock were not computed, because this session has no shell.

classify-risk.sh and check-traceability.sh were read only where they touch the lock, not run.
